title: Seoul says Kim's China visit may have involved discussions on US-N. Korea dialogue
caption:
South Korean officials believe a secret meeting in Dandong could signal a restart for US-North Korea dialogue. The presence of a high-ranking Chinese diplomat suggests that Beijing and Pyongyang are looking beyond local trade toward a potential summit with Washington.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul says Kim's China visit may have involved discussions on US-N. Korea dialogue
